S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.

subtypes.Reduced Concentration: Unable to pay attention or maintain focus on specific activities like conversation, reading, or watching TV.
subtypes.Indecisiveness: Extreme difficulty making even minor daily choices (e.g., menu, clothes) and hesitating to make decisions.
subtypes.Subjective Memory Complaints: Complaining of memory decline, such as forgetting where things were placed, due to reduced focus.
subtypes.Clouded Thinking: Thinking feels foggy, dazed, or not clear.

S042.name: Low_Self_Esteem
S042.description: A persistent tendency to evaluate oneself as incompetent or worthless; chronically low self-evaluation.

subtypes.Feelings of Worthlessness: A persistent perception that one is useless or inferior to others.
subtypes.Self-Criticism: Excessively and repeatedly blaming oneself for past minor failures or flaws.
subtypes.Reduced Self-Efficacy: Distrust in one's own ability to perform tasks or solve problems.
subtypes.Chronic Sense of Inferiority: Persistently evaluating oneself lower in comparison to others.
subtypes.Lack of Self-Assurance: Continually feeling anxious and unsure about decisions or actions.

info.persona: Juancarlos Gonzalez is a methodical, eco‑focused janitor who blends disciplined work habits with a love for traditional flavors, community clean‑ups, and strategic financial planning, yet wrestles with chronic worry and occasional impulsive splurges.
info.professional_persona: Juancarlos Gonzalez, a 35‑year‑old janitorial master, applies his OSHA‑savvy, inventory‑control precision and systematic maintenance routines to keep large property sites immaculate, and he maps out every step toward Certified Professional Cleaner and a supervisory leap with the same meticulous checklist mindset that defines his work.
info.cultural_background: Juancarlos identifies as Puerto Rican, raised in a bilingual household where Spanish and English are spoken interchangeably. He maintains cultural ties through family gatherings that celebrate holidays like Noche Buena, cooking traditional dishes, and listening to bomba and plena music. While living in Leander, Texas, he blends his heritage with local Texan customs, often attending community events and integrating his Catholic upbringing into his weekly routines.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his downtime, Juancarlos enjoys solitary activities that allow for planning and precision, such as building a small succulent garden, experimenting with traditional Puerto Rican recipes like arroz con gandules, and playing chess online. He also follows Puerto Rican soccer, watches classic reggaetón music videos, and participates in a weekly neighborhood clean‑up group, blending his love for community service with his structured mindset.
info.sports_persona: Juancarlos Gonzalez follows the spirited matches of the San Juan‑based soccer club and rallies for the Dallas Cowboys while occasionally joining a local adult soccer league for a structured workout, and they stay active through weekend neighborhood clean‑ups that double as a low‑impact fitness routine.
info.arts_persona: Juancarlos Gonzalez immerses in the rhythmic beats of bomba and plena during family gatherings, streams classic reggaetón videos from artists like Daddy Yankee and Yandel, and attends occasional performances at the local community theater where they appreciate the blend of tradition and modern storytelling.
info.travel_persona: Juancarlos Gonzalez plans trips with spreadsheets, having already explored the historic streets of Old San Juan and the vibrant food markets of Austin, while dreaming of a sustainable eco‑tour of Costa Rica’s rainforests, always balancing wanderlust with the financial goal of securing a mortgage in Leander.
info.culinary_persona: Juancarlos Gonzalez perfects arroz con gandules using fresh cilantro, sofrito, and pigeon peas, experiments with plant‑based twists for neighbor potlucks, and tends a meticulous succulent garden that supplies them with aromatic herbs like oregano and thyme for their home‑cooked meals.

info.persona: Concepcion Nieves blends analytical rigor with a contemplative love for literature, plants, and heritage cuisine, balancing a disciplined career trajectory with solitary yet purposeful hobbies, while they occasionally succumb to the comfort of late‑night novel marathons.
info.professional_persona: Concepcion Nieves, a senior financial analyst with two decades of experience, leverages advanced Excel, VBA, Bloomberg Terminal, and Python to build rigorous financial models while applying their disciplined, methodical work habits to deliver transparent, data‑driven investment insights for Caribbean market clients.
info.cultural_background: Concepción was raised in a bilingual Puerto Rican household, where family gatherings, music, and cuisine instilled a strong sense of community and cultural pride. Her heritage influences her values of cooperation, harmony, and respect for others, and she maintains active ties to the Puerto Rican diaspora in Wellington, Florida. She frequently supports local Latin businesses, participates in community events such as fiestas patronales, and preserves traditions by cooking arroz con gandules and sharing stories of island life. This cultural grounding enriches her professional perspective, especially when analyzing Caribbean markets or communicating with Spanish-speaking clients.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Concepción seeks balance through solitary yet purposeful activities that align with her reflective nature. She enjoys immersing herself in historical novels and contemporary Latin American literature, cultivating a modest garden of tropical plants, and preparing traditional Puerto Rican dishes for a few close friends. Regular yoga practice and early morning walks along the Atlantic shoreline help her maintain mental clarity and resilience. She participates in a small, intimate book club at a local café, volunteers occasionally at a community center teaching basic financial concepts in Spanish, and attends occasional cultural festivals that celebrate Puerto Rican heritage.
info.sports_persona: Concepcion Nieves, an avid early‑morning walker along the Atlantic shoreline, also participates in the Miami Beach Running Club’s weekly 5K sessions, follows the Miami Heat and Miami Dolphins for seasonal excitement, and practices gentle Vinyasa yoga at the South Beach Yoga Collective to maintain flexibility and mental clarity.
info.arts_persona: Concepcion Nieves immerses themselves in literary arts through a book club that discusses works by Gabriel García Márquez, Isabel Allende, and Julia de Burgos, while their evenings often feature listening to Rubén Blades and appreciating Frida Kahlo’s paintings during local gallery visits.
info.travel_persona: Concepcion Nieves prefers carefully planned trips that combine cultural immersion and relaxation, having explored historic Old San Juan, the colonial streets of Cartagena, the vineyards of Mendoza, and the serene beaches of Key West, and they now dream of a leisurely cruise through the Greek islands while balancing a modest travel budget.
info.culinary_persona: Concepcion Nieves, a confident home cook, delights in preparing traditional island dishes such as mofongo, arroz con gandules, and tostones for their close friends, sourcing fresh plantains, sofrito, and adobo spices from local markets, and they enjoy occasional dining at upscale Caribbean‑fusion restaurants.

info.persona: Stephen Goodson is a pragmatic, community‑driven driver whose meticulous schedule‑checking, anxiety‑fuelled over‑commitment to volunteering, and habit of humming classic‑rock solos while inspecting their vintage truck define a uniquely dependable yet restless personality.
info.professional_persona: Stephen Goodson, a veteran commercial truck driver with two decades of route‑planning expertise and a knack for mechanical troubleshooting, leverages their outgoing, cooperative style and strict safety compliance record to excel in customer interactions and now pursues a supervisory logistics coordinator role to reduce long‑haul stress while mentoring younger drivers.
info.cultural_background: Stephen was born and raised in the greater Boston suburbs of Massachusetts, growing up in a working‑class, white New England family that emphasized reliability, community service, and a pragmatic outlook. His upbringing was shaped by the region’s seasonal rhythms, local traditions such as neighborhood block parties and seasonal festivals, and a cultural emphasis on punctuality and self‑reliance. These values are reflected in his courteous demeanor, cooperative nature, and strong sense of responsibility toward his neighbors and local charities.
info.hobbies_and_interests: When he’s not on the road, Stephen enjoys group activities that combine his sociable spirit with his love for the outdoors. He plays in a community softball league, goes fishing on nearby lakes with fellow drivers, and volunteers at the local food pantry. He attends evening yoga classes to help manage anxiety, tends a plot in a community garden, and participates in a regional classic‑rock fan club. In his downtime, he likes tinkering with a vintage car project and occasionally attends community theatre productions as an audience member.
info.sports_persona: Stephen Goodson plays third base for the Brookline Community Softball League, roots for the Boston Red Sox and New England Patriots, spends spring weekends fishing on Lake Quinsigamond with fellow drivers, and uses evening yoga sessions to balance the physical demands of their active, team‑focused lifestyle.
info.arts_persona: Stephen Goodson is a devoted member of a regional classic‑rock fan club, frequently streaming The Rolling Stones and Led Zeppelin while commuting, enjoys attending productions at the Boston Repertory Theatre, and occasionally tinkers with vintage car restoration as a form of creative expression, all of which enrich their appreciation for timeless American cultural icons.
info.travel_persona: Stephen Goodson prefers meticulously planned weekend road trips—such as a sunrise drive to Acadia National Park, a nostalgic visit to Cape Cod’s lobster shacks, and an upcoming pilgrimage to Liverpool to walk the Beatles' historic sites—balancing a love for scenic routes with budget constraints and family obligations.
info.culinary_persona: Stephen Goodson delights in cooking hearty New England fare—clamming the classic New England clam chowder, grilling fresh trout with dill and lemon, and savoring baked beans seasoned with maple syrup—while also appreciating a well‑cooked steak at the local tavern, though they often resort to quick microwave meals during tight delivery schedules.
